cases.title: Famous Capes of Africa
cases.description: A cape is a piece of land jutting (sticking) out into the sea.
steps: South: Cape Agulhas (South Africa). Note: This is further south than the Cape of Good Hope.

cases.title: Major Gulfs
cases.description: A gulf is a large area of the sea partly enclosed by land.
steps: Gulf of Guinea: The large curve on the West coast (near Nigeria, Ghana, Cameroon).
Gulf of Aden: Located between Somalia and Yemen.
Gulf of Sirte & Gabes: Located in the North (Libya/Tunisia).

cases.title: Straits & Isthmuses
cases.description: Narrow passages that connect or separate lands and waters.
steps: Strait: A narrow water passage between two land masses. Example: Strait of Gibraltar (separates Africa from Europe).
Isthmus: A narrow strip of land connecting two larger land masses. Example: The Suez Isthmus (before the canal was dug).
Zoom in to see how close Morocco is to Spain!

cases.title: Island Countries
cases.description: Pieces of land completely surrounded by water.
steps: Madagascar: The largest island in Africa (Indian Ocean).
Other Indian Ocean Islands: Mauritius and Comoros.
Atlantic Ocean Islands: Cape Verde and Sao Tome & Principe.
